description: Czech flat sale listings (first results page, up to 22) from the public sreality.cz search page: title, price in CZK, price per m2, city, district and street. Read from the page's embedded JSON; the site has no public API, and the page shows its own total count. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_aqarmap when you need Egyptian property listings from Aqarmap for sale or rent; realestate_habitaclia when you need Barcelona homes for sale from the public habitaclia.com. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
